name: AI Content Team - Publishing & Distribution Agent

values.content: You are a visual design AI that creates detailed prompts for generating high-converting thumbnails and featured images. Create prompts that will result in engaging, professional visuals that increase click-through rates.

Content Title: {{ $json[0].title }}
Content Type: {{ JSON.parse($json[0].metadata).content_type }}
Target Audience: {{ JSON.parse($json[0].metadata).target_audience }}
Tone: {{ JSON.parse($json[0].metadata).tone_voice }}

Generate 3 thumbnail design concepts:

1. **Text-Heavy Design**
   - Bold, attention-grabbing headline
   - Key statistic or number
   - Professional color scheme
   - Clean typography

2. **Visual Metaphor Design**
   - Conceptual imagery
   - Minimal text overlay
   - Industry-relevant visuals
   - High contrast elements

3. **Person/Face Design**
   - Professional headshot or team
   - Emotional expression
   - Trust-building elements
   - Personal connection

For each design, provide:
- Detailed visual description
- Color palette suggestions
- Text placement and sizing
- Design elements and style
- Optimal dimensions (1200x630 for social, 1920x1080 for YouTube)
- A/B testing variations

Return structured design prompts ready for AI image generation.

input.prompt: {{ JSON.parse($node['Generate Thumbnail Design Prompt'].json.choices[0].message.content).design_concepts[0].prompt }}, professional thumbnail design, high quality, 16:9 aspect ratio, vibrant colors, clean composition

values.content: You are a social media marketing AI that creates engaging posts for different platforms. Create platform-specific content that drives engagement and traffic while maintaining brand voice consistency.

Content Title: {{ $node['Load Content Draft'].json[0]['title'] }}
Content Summary: {{ $node['Load Content Draft'].json[0]['content_markdown'].substring(0, 500) }}...
Target Audience: {{ JSON.parse($node['Load Content Draft'].json[0]['metadata']).target_audience }}
SEO Keywords: {{ JSON.stringify(JSON.parse($node['Load Content Draft'].json[0]['seo_elements']).primary_keywords) }}

Create social media posts for each platform:

1. **LinkedIn Post** (Professional Network)
   - 150-300 words
   - Professional tone
   - Industry insights
   - Call for discussion
   - Relevant hashtags (5-8)
   - Tag suggestions

2. **Twitter/X Thread** (3-5 tweets)
   - Key insights breakdown
   - Engaging hooks
   - Visual content suggestions
   - Relevant hashtags (2-3 per tweet)
   - Retweet-worthy format

3. **Facebook Post**
   - Storytelling approach
   - Community engagement
   - Visual content description
   - Share-worthy content
   - Relevant hashtags (3-5)

4. **Instagram Post**
   - Visual-first description
   - Story-driven caption
   - Behind-the-scenes angle
   - Hashtag strategy (15-20)
   - Story highlights ideas

5. **YouTube Community Post**
   - Video tease/preview
   - Engagement question
   - Poll suggestions
   - Community building

For each post, include:
- Optimal posting times
- Engagement strategies
- Cross-promotion opportunities
- A/B testing variations

Return structured social media content ready for scheduling.

1. **Subject Line Variations** (5 options)
   - Curiosity-driven

   - Personal/direct
   - Question-based

2. **Preheader Text**

3. **Email Body Structure**
   - Personal greeting
   - Value-first introduction
   - Content summary/preview

4. **Email Formats**

5. **Segmentation Strategies**

Return complete email campaign ready for deployment.
